summary: iter59 — pending-orders click-to-expand drawer + Mark-as-shipped flow fully verified end-to-end. Backend 8/8 PASS via /app/backend/tests/test_iter59_order_detail.py: (1) GET /api/maker/orders list now returns buyer_name+order_status+shipped_at+tracking_carrier+tracking_number on every row; (2) GET /api/maker/orders/{session_id} detail returns full payload (buyer_email, buyer_name, items[image,price,qty,subtotal], shipping{name,phone,address}, buyer_note, shipped_at, tracking_*); (3) Detail requires maker auth (401/403 unauth); (4) Cross-maker isolation — metalart-pro receives 404 for an iron-and-oak session_id; (5) Bogus session_id → 404; (6) POST /api/maker/orders/{sid}/ship with {tracking_carrier,tracking_number} returns ok=true + order_status=fulfilled + shipped_at, and persistence verified by re-GETting the detail; (7) Cross-maker ship attempt → 404; (8) Bogus sid ship → 404. Frontend live-tested on /maker/dashboard?tab=orders for iron-and-oak: orders-list renders both seeded pending orders (Jane Wilson $149, Mark Kowalski $158); click order-toggle-{sid} opens order-detail-{sid} drawer with Buyer/Ship-to grid (Jane → 1240 Maple Street, Portland OR 97205, +1-555-0101), yellow buyer-note callout (gift-wrap text), Items section with image, and Mark-as-shipped form (order-carrier-* select with USPS/UPS/FedEx/DHL/Other, order-tracking-* input, order-ship-* button). Opening a second drawer leaves first drawer open (independent state — confirmed). Second click on first row collapses it. After filling tracking + clicking Mark shipped, toast 'Order marked as shipped.' appears and list reloads — Pending count goes from 2→1, Fulfilled count from 1→2 (visible in tab labels). Cross-maker, auth-required, and 404 paths all enforced server-side. PageErrors=0 net-new (only pre-existing iter51-carryover 'duplicate key in DashboardTab' warnings).
critical_code_review_comments: [good] Cross-maker isolation in /maker/orders/{sid} returns 404 (not 403) — prevents existence leakage as the design note states. Same 404 used for both 'tx not found' and 'no overlap with my products' paths.

[good] Stripe live-retrieve is wrapped in try/except logged at INFO level with a substring guard (skips cs_test_seed* and any non-cs_ session) — won't break seeded test data and won't 500 on Stripe outages.
[good] Successful Stripe retrieve caches shipping_details on the tx doc with updated_at — subsequent opens of the same drawer skip the network round-trip.

[good] Mark-shipped endpoint re-checks cross-maker ownership independently of the detail endpoint — defense in depth (a maker can't bypass isolation by guessing a session_id and POSTing /ship even if they never opened the detail).
[good] OrderRow uses local useState for open/detail/loadingDetail/busyShip — independent rows don't share state, confirmed by opening 2 drawers simultaneously.
[good] handleShip calls onChange after success which triggers list reload from MakerDashboard — moves the row across tabs without manual refresh.
[minor] /maker/orders/{sid}/ship calls db.products.find twice (once for ids, once for slugs) — could be a single round-trip projecting both fields. Negligible at small N.
[minor·carry-over] DashboardTab continues to log 'duplicate key' React warnings (3-4 per render). Pre-existing; not introduced by iter59. Triage in a future iteration.

[minor] On the empty-state case (no orders), navigator.share() Promise rejection is unhandled — fine for desktop but on mobile a user dismissing the native share sheet logs an unhandled rejection. Wrap in .catch(()=>{}).
[minor] Detail drawer's 'Loading detail…' state has no min-height so the row visibly jumps when the fetch resolves — consider a skeleton or fixed-height placeholder.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — drawer expand/collapse, multi-row independence, mark-shipped flow with toast + list reload all working
